response.sql: WITH customer_spend AS (SELECT c.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS amount_spent FROM Customer c LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId), customer_share AS (SELECT amount_spent, amount_spent * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(amount_spent) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM customer_spend), compared AS (SELECT amount_spent, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM customer_share) SELECT AVG(amount_spent) AS average_amount_spent, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_share_above_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share
